accordion.name: 1. Can I track how many times a QR code has been scanned?
accordion.answer: Yes. $t(common:appName) offers real-time scan tracking, including total scans, device types, and more — making it easy to measure campaign performance.

accordion.name: 2. Are short links secure? Will they be marked as spam?
accordion.answer: Absolutely secure. $t(common:appName) uses encryption and trusted domains to ensure your links stay safe and avoid being flagged as spam.

accordion.name: 3. Can I embed short links in emails, SMS, or Zalo?
accordion.answer: Yes. $t(common:appName) short links work seamlessly across platforms like email marketing, SMS, Zalo OA, and social media. Clean links improve click rates and reduce spam filtering.

accordion.name: 4. Do $t(common:appName) links contain third-party ads?
accordion.answer: No. Your Short Links and QR Codes are ad-free. You control the redirection of content and appearance — without unwanted pop-ups or banners.
